title: Feedback
description: Measure what a machine does, compare it with what it should do, and push it back by the difference. Every thermostat works this way.

puzzle.goal: A machine multiplies what goes in by G; what comes out is scaled by H and taken away from what goes in. Write the overall gain T, out over in.
puzzle.name: Black's loop
puzzle.ask: Find T for G = 100 and H = @{H}.
puzzle.method: out = G(in − H·out), so out(1 + GH) = G·in. With a large G it is close to 1/H, whatever G does.
